updates.content:
Title: Admins are unable to complete cross-tenant Microsoft OneDrive migrations

User impact: Admins are unable to complete cross-tenant OneDrive migrations.

More info: Admins may see some migration jobs remain in the Scheduled/Queued state. 

Current status: We're analyzing support provided information to determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and admins attempting to complete cross-tenant OneDrive migrations are impacted.

Next update by: Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 12:30 PM UTC

Title: Admins are unable to complete Microsoft OneDrive or SharePoint site migrations

User impact: Admins are unable to complete OneDrive or SharePoint site migrations.

More info: Several migration workflows may experience impact, which include:
- Newly initiated Cross-Geo OneDrive or SharePoint site moves will fail to start.
- Newly initiated Cross-Tenant OneDrive or SharePoint site migrations will fail to start.
- Admins may see some migration jobs remain in the Scheduled/Queued state.

Current status: We've identified the source of the issue, and have developed a fix which we are currently testing. Once the validations are complete, we'll start deployment.

Scope of impact: This issue will impact any admins attempting to perform OneDrive or SharePoint site migrations. This applies only to the M365 Multi-Geo and Cross-Tenant Migration features for SharePoint and OneDrive. Other modes of migration, such as Migration Manager (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepointmigration/mm-get-started) or 3rd party tools, are not affected. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 6:29 PM UTC
